description: This file defines the internal class 'CosmosGatewayListProvider' that implements the 'IGatewayListProvider' interface. It manages the retrieval of gateway URIs for Orleans clusters from an Azure Cosmos DB container by querying and processing 'SiloEntity' records.

classes.name: CosmosGatewayListProvider
classes.description: Implements the gateway list provider interface for Cosmos DB integration, providing methods to initialize and retrieve active gateway URIs from Cosmos.

methods.name: CosmosGatewayListProvider
methods.description: Constructor that initializes dependencies and configuration options.

methods.name: InitializeGatewayListProvider
methods.description: Asynchronously initializes the Cosmos DB container client for subsequent usage.

methods.name: GetGateways
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the list of active gateway URIs from Cosmos DB by querying 'SiloEntity' records.

methods.name: ConvertToGatewayUri
methods.description: Converts a 'SiloEntity' object into its corresponding Gateway URI.
